missing_value_mappings.policy: Preserve explicit NaN/None. Never replace missing measurements with zero or normal values.

safeguards_enforced: Blood pressure 99 mmHg preserved as valid physiological reading
Age 98/99 preserved as valid older adult age
Missing clinical vitals never coerced to zero or normal values
Missing diagnoses never coerced to False
Missing weights flagged explicitly and excluded from weighted estimates

pseudonymization.confidentiality_notice: CONFIDENTIALITY AND LEGAL NOTICE: Cryptographic pseudonymization replaces direct identifiers with deterministic HMAC-SHA256 digests to prevent inadvertent exposure in operational artifacts. Pseudonymization does NOT constitute full statistical disclosure limitation or anonymization under Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act or IIPS / Gateway to Global Aging Data Use Agreements. Microdata contains quasi-identifiers (demographic profiles, geographic strata, clinical measurements) that may permit re-identification if combined with external auxiliary datasets. Genuine reference microdata must remain confined to encrypted, access-controlled enclaves and must NEVER be exported, committed to version control, or transmitted outside authorized environments.

diagnostic_warnings: SINGLETON PSUs: 1 strata contain exactly 1 PSU (e.g. ['ST_13']). Design variance estimation requires explicit singleton handling (certainty, centering, or collapsing).
SPARSE DOMAINS: Sample size n < 30 or n_eff < 25 in domains: Male_45_54, Male_55_64, Male_65_74, Male_75_plus, Female_45_54, Female_55_64, Female_65_74, Female_75_plus.

access_control_notice: CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: Reference participant microdata is subject to strict Data Use Agreement (DUA) restrictions under IIPS / Gateway to Global Aging. Participant-level identifiers and raw records must never be exported to version control.
